verdict.rationale: The evidence pack confirms Trivy's built-in secret scanner detects passwords, API keys, and tokens (trivy-docs-3, trivy-docs-10, trivy-probe-6), but nothing in the pack documents a mechanism for security engineers to define custom regex/rule sets for organization-specific token formats. missing for 10: any mention of custom secret detection rule configuration (e.g., custom regex patterns, allow/deny lists, rule files), documentation or examples of extending the secret scanner for proprietary token formats.
